title: PPA actuator registry v1
description: The set of actions a closure controller is AUTHORISED to take, and the measurements that judge them. An entry is an authorisation, not a tool name: 'OpenROAD is allowed' authorises nothing, `timing.hold.emit_repair_block` with margin_ps in [0,500] and max_buffer_percent in (0,5] authorises one bounded action. Frozen as v1: a change that would invalidate a hash taken against this file is v2, per docs/PPA_INTERFACES.md section 5.

actuators.description: action_id -> authorisation. The key is the action id.

domains.description: domain name -> the measurement that answers it and the target it is judged against.

edges.description: Flow step id, RAW as flow/phase1_phase2_phase3.yaml declares it (ids are not all integers: 1.6x, A7, A9 are strings), -> the controller bound to that step's closed_loop edge, or null. null means DECLARED_ONLY and it may never be displayed as a closed-loop success.

binding.description: EXECUTABLE claims the named program is in the tree and the claim IS CHECKED (Registry.verify_bindings). DECLARED_ONLY names no program at all, so the label and the tree cannot disagree.

wrapper.description: A FIXED argv. There is no shell key and no shell in the executor; `shell`, `shell_command` and `command_line` are refused at load.

program.description: A bare program name resolved as programs/<name>.py. No separator, no dot segment, no absolute path -- refused BEFORE resolution, because resolving first is how a `..` gets to be a real path for one instant.

argv_template.description: argv items appended after the interpreter and the program. Every {placeholder} must be a declared parameter.

parameters.description: Typed parameters. A parameter named argv/args/cmd/command/script/shell/exec/eval/tcl/python/code/expr/extra_args/raw is refused: a typed field may not carry a script, a command or an argv fragment.

path.description: Relative to the implementation root; may interpolate declared parameters. An absolute path or one that escapes the root is refused.

preconditions.description: Evaluable conditions only. A prose precondition is not a precondition.

blast_radius.description: Ordered smallest to largest. rollback NONE is admissible only at NET.

resource_ceilings.description: Required. An unbounded actuator is not authorised, it is merely unmeasured.

remeasure_domains.description: Every domain this action can disturb. A regression in ANY of them rolls the iteration back even when the objective improved -- that is what this field is FOR. An empty list is refused: an action whose effect nobody re-measures is an action with no evidence.

unit.description: Required for number and integer: a bound without a unit is a bound on nothing.

maximum.description: The ceiling IS the authorisation. A request beyond it is refused, never clamped.

metric.description: The canonical metric name that goes into a vibeic.ppa.metric.v1 record.

flow_steps.description: The flow steps a full re-run would have to re-execute for this domain. Recorded so a run record can state what was NOT re-run in-process. Naming them is the difference between a limitation and a lie.

argv_template.description: Supports {impl_root}, {json_out}, and {glob:<pattern>} which expands to every matching file under the implementation root, sorted, as separate argv items.

undetermined_rcs.description: Exit codes from the measurement program that mean 'I could not look'. They become NOT_MEASURED with a reason, never a number. Repeating a refusal honestly is the point; turning it into a value would launder it into a fact.

extract.description: How a number is lifted out of a measurement's --json. Declarative on purpose: an extractor that could run code would put a second, unreviewed program inside a config file.

kind.description: json_pointer reads a number directly (status MEASURED). bool_fraction and list_length COMPUTE one, so the record is DERIVED and carries its formula. bool_fraction over an empty or absent list is NOT_MEASURED, never 1.0 -- a fraction over a zero denominator is undefined.

flag.description: bool_fraction only: the boolean key on each element.

objective_domain.description: Must appear in the actuator's remeasure_domains: the thing being optimised must be the thing being re-measured.

plan.description: An ORDERED ladder of parameter proposals. Deterministic on purpose: re-running takes the same actions in the same order. Candidate generation, budget allocation and multi-fidelity belong to _ppa/search.py; a controller that invented its own search would make the two disagree about what a run cost.

stop.description: Required. A loop with no declared stop condition is a loop.
